summary.text: Renee Erickson is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 30 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2021.
Renee Erickson is listed as chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Renee Erickson served in the House (2019–2020) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2021.
Renee Erickson is listed as a member of the Education Committee, the Government Efficiency Committee, the Public Health and Welfare Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
The Legislature lists Renee Erickson's occupation as Retired.
The page names Roger Erickson as Renee Erickson's spouse.
